findings.summary: Spec §1 deliverable 3 (natural convergence) is not implemented. Spec §0.4 pins the measured root cause of hitting max_passes instead of drained to the seed trigger permanently staying `open` and being re-claimable every round, and §1.3 requires that a consumed seed trigger reach a terminal state. No product change touches the trigger lifecycle: tick.md still only puts a NEW `status:"open"` trigger when hasPendingWork is true and never completes/closes the trigger it consumed, and the fleet claim/complete block is unchanged from A9. Fixing harvest cannot make an always-`open` trigger stop being re-claimed, so `pending.status: open` still counts it every round.

Hard acceptance C5 and C6 are unmet and unevidenced. Spec §2 requires a real `bin/deep-research-loop.sh` run asserting `reason === "drained"` (C5) and a real evidence-channel read showing `research.evidence.v2` count > 0 (C6), with §2.1 requiring pre/post message-count deltas recorded in dev-notes and C9 requiring the evidence written to dev-notes. The dev-note instead marks C5/C6 as '真机验证（本包脚本化验收 gate 之真跑）', i.e. deferred, and records no run output and no message-count delta. The A9 note carries such a record for its F0, so the omission here is not a house-style gap.

The shape guard does not enforce presence of the schema's required keys, so the exact A10 failure mode survives for any other shape drift. `assertWorkerResultShape` only rejects the known legacy singular `evidence` and non-array types; a result missing `evidences`/`proposed_clues`/`materials` entirely passes, then `result.evidences ?? []` yields an empty list, `needed` collapses to 1, and the card is CAS'd to `explored` with zero publishes — precisely the '0 发布 + CAS explored' silent pass C2 forbids. Spec §1.2 states that '确实无产出' may only be established by explicit evidence (result present AND `evidences` an EMPTY ARRAY), and the registered schema marks all three keys required, so absence must be rejected loudly rather than defaulted.

C0 is not satisfied: the fixture shape is still hand-written rather than derived from a source of truth. Spec §2 C0 requires the test to read field names from the registered `profiles/roles/schemas/worker-result.v1.json` or from a frozen real-bus product fixture, explicitly forbidding hand-written shapes. The test hardcodes `SCHEMA_REQUIRED = ["evidences","proposed_clues","materials"]` and an inline `frozenRealPayload` object literal, then asserts one hand-written literal against the other. No schema file and no frozen-payload fixture file exists anywhere in the repo, so nothing anchors the fixture to reality — the same 'fixture and code share one wrong model' failure C0 exists to prevent.

The dev-note's convergence rationale contradicts the spec's measured root cause and is presented as if it closed deliverable 3. It argues that fixing the harvest shape and no_result semantics makes the board reach all-terminal so hasPendingWork=false stops re-injection and drain exits 'drained'. Spec §0.4 already measured that re-injection never happened in F0 (the trigger store held only the single seed entry) and that the 16 rounds came from the seed trigger being re-claimable while `open`. The stated mechanism therefore cannot explain or fix the observed non-convergence.

The §3 mutation self-check (M1-M5) is absent. Spec §3 requires each mutation to be applied, the changed line echoed, the killing criterion recorded, and the tree restored with a clean diff confirmation; §3.1 adds explicit discipline rules. The dev-note contains no mutation section at all, so there is no evidence that C0-C4 actually kill M1-M5 — and M4 ('收敛判定恒为「还有活」') is mapped to C5, which was never executed.

The core shape fix itself is correct and matches the registered payload: `result.evidences` (plural array) and `result.proposed_clues` (bare array) replace the legacy reads, and the no_result branch now returns `casExplored: false` so the card stays in_flight while reporting `skippedReason: "no_result"`, with C4's present-but-empty `evidences` case kept discriminative against it. Deliverables §1.1 and §1.2 are satisfied; only §1.3 and the C0/C5/C6 acceptance obligations are outstanding.
